methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Energy performance indicators were identified (3 in the current study) and objectives were formulated to reduce the steam consumption in processes and reduce coal consumption or boiler efficiency enhancement

paper_type.evidence_quote: This work presents a case study of energy management system implementation in Pakistan.

level_3b.evidence_quote: This paper presents the implementation of ISO 50001 in a textile unit of Pakistan

stage1.notes: Textile unit case; textile is outside the closed continuous-process list, so level_3b=false. EnPIs are specific-consumption ratios (SFC); boiler efficiency computed via a thermodynamic equation.

multi_site.evidence_quote: Shafi Texcel Ltd. is situated near Sunder Industrial estate at Raiwind Manga Road

country_region.evidence_quote: It is considered one of the major textiles in Punjab province of Pakistan

sector_of_activity.evidence_quote: Textile sector is a big consumer of energy

type_of_organisation.evidence_quote: There are three sub units in Shafi Texcel limited (STL) which are Yarn dyeing, Weaving and processing

ems_standard.evidence_quote: ISO 50001:2001 energy management system was implemented in Shafi Texcel Ltd.

evidence_quote: SFC decreased from 145 kg of coal/ton of steam to 125 kg of coal/ton of steam
H = Enthalpy of steam at generated pressure
